imports_source_timetable_hint: A screenshot or PDF of your weekly timetable.

imports_pick_files: Choose files or drop them here

imports_add_more: Add more files, or drop them here
imports_text_placeholder: Course code, title, meeting times, grading…
imports_review_hint: Check what was found. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
imports_file_waiting: Waiting for the file to be processed
imports_discard_description: What was read is deleted. Nothing has been saved yet.

imports_history_empty_hint: Imports started from the term wizard, the gradebook or a schedule show up here.

error_import_term_unresolved: Couldn't tell which term this belongs to
error_import_outside_term: These dates are outside the term

error_import_ics_invalid: This isn't a calendar file that can be read

error_import_session_not_ready: This import is still being read

error_import_no_changes: The course info is already up to date
tasks_description: Task lists, smart lists, due dates and tasks from assessments.
tasks_managed_note: The title, due date and course follow the assessment.
tasks_clear_description: {count} completed tasks will be deleted. This can't be undone.
tasks_quick_add_placeholder: Add a task, e.g. “Fri lab report !!!”
tasks_list_delete_tasks: Also delete its tasks (otherwise they move to Unsorted)
tasks_empty_description: Type in the box above to add one.
settings_assistant_show_reasoning_descri: Show what the model thought before answering in the folded thinking block. When off, the block only lists the steps and how long it thought.
settings_lms_allow_writes_description: Let Semestra change things in your LMS account. For now that's only marking an announcement read on Canvas when you open it here. Off: Semestra only reads.
settings_tasks_auto_tasks_from_assessmen: Every assessment with a due date gets a task that follows it. Completing the task does not affect the grade.
settings_tasks_default_priority_descript: Used for tasks you add without a priority. Existing tasks keep theirs.
settings_tasks_show_completed_in_lists_d: Otherwise they are only under Completed.
error_tasks_list_name_conflict: A list with this name already exists.
error_tasks_course_not_in_program: This course is not in this program.
error_tasks_managed_by_assessment: This task follows its assessment. Its title, due date and course can only change in the gradebook.
tasks_empty_scheduled_description: Tasks with a due date appear here.
lms_description: Connect a learning platform such as Canvas, link courses and import their courses, assignments and calendar.
lms_settings_connections_description: Learning platforms you sign in to with an API token.
lms_settings_writes_description: Whether Semestra may change things in your LMS account, or only read.
lms_settings_program_description: The connection this program's courses link through.
lms_settings_course_description: The platform course this course is linked to.
lms_canvas_token_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved token. A new address needs it again.
lms_canvas_help_title: How to get an API token
lms_canvas_help_step_new: Under Approved integrations, choose New access token
lms_canvas_help_step_copy: Copy the token into the field above. Canvas shows it only once.
lms_canvas_description: Your school's Canvas site, connected with a personal API token.
lms_connection_note: The token is checked before saving and stored encrypted; it is never shown again.
lms_connection_pick_provider: Choose the LMS provider your school uses.
lms_connection_delete_desc: {name} and its saved token will be removed.
lms_connection_delete_in_use: {name} is used by {programs} programs. Deleting it also removes {courses} course links; your courses, assessments and tasks stay.
lms_connections_empty_hint: Add your school's LMS to link and import courses.
lms_binding_description: Courses of this program link to courses on this connection's LMS provider.
lms_binding_locked: {count} courses are linked through this connection. Unlink them in their course settings to change it.
lms_binding_needs_connection: Add a connection in account settings first, then choose it here.
lms_course_program_unbound: No LMS connection for this program
lms_course_program_unbound_hint: Choose a connection in the program's settings first.
lms_course_not_linked_hint: Link it to its course on the LMS provider in the course settings.
lms_course_pick_description: The course on {provider} that matches this one.
lms_course_change_desc: Assignments imported from the current course stay, but their changes are no longer noticed and they may show twice in the calendar if you link it again.
lms_course_unlink_desc: Its platform calendar and update notices stop. Imported assessments and tasks stay.
lms_course_sync_description: Show the platform's calendar and notice changed assignments.
lms_import_courses_hint: Pick courses from your LMS provider; they are linked as they are created.
lms_import_assignments_hint: Pick assignments to add as assessments or tasks.
lms_updates_banner: {count} imported assignments have changes or new grades on {provider}
error_lms_forbidden: The token has no access to this
error_lms_unreachable: The platform can't be reached right now
error_lms_rate_limited: The platform is busy. Try again in {retry_after} seconds
error_lms_writes_disabled: Changes on the platform are turned off in settings
error_lms_file_too_large: This file is too large to preview
error_lms_program_not_configured: This program has no LMS connection
error_lms_program_has_links: {count} courses are still linked through this connection
error_lms_course_not_linked: This course isn't linked to the platform
error_lms_course_link_exists: This course is already linked to another platform course
error_lms_course_already_linked: Another course is already linked to it
canvas_tab_description: Browse a linked Canvas course without leaving the app: announcements, assignments, grades, modules, pages, quizzes and the syllabus.
canvas_tab_requirements: Add a Canvas connection in settings and link the course to its Canvas course first.
canvas_tab_credentials_hint: Enter a new API token for the Canvas connection, then come back.
canvas_tab_forbidden_hint: This account can't see it in Canvas, or it isn't open yet. You can check in Canvas.
canvas_tab_grades_cta_title: Work out GPA and targets in the gradebook
canvas_tab_grades_cta_description: These are Canvas's own scores. The gradebook computes your GPA and what you need on what's left.
canvas_tab_page_locked: This page is locked in Canvas
canvas_tab_external_description: This is an external tool. It only runs inside Canvas.
canvas_tab_unknown_title: This page can't be shown here yet
canvas_tab_file_save_unavailable: Saving to course files isn't available yet
canvas_tab_file_no_preview: No preview for this file type
canvas_tab_module_sequential: Items must be done in order
canvas_tab_files_truncated: Only the first files are shown. Open the folder in Canvas to see the rest.
canvas_tab_preview_text_only: Text only: layout, images and charts aren't shown. Download the file to see it as made.
canvas_tab_preview_truncated: Only the first {count} pages are shown.
error_lms_assignment_already_imported: “{title}” was already imported from the platform
portability_description: Back up, restore and delete your account
portability_export_desc: Download a backup of all your data
portability_export_files_desc: Pack your uploaded files into the backup too ({size}).
portability_export_contents: Programs, terms, courses, grades, schedules, settings and plugin data. Secrets such as API tokens and service provider keys are never included; enter them again after restoring.
portability_export_recent_desc: Each backup can be downloaded for 24 hours.
portability_restore_desc: Import a backup exported from Semestra
portability_restore_mode_desc: Merge adds the backup as new data. Replace deletes your current data first.
portability_restore_mode_merge_hint: Add the backup's data next to what you have.
portability_restore_mode_replace_hint: Delete all your current data first, then restore the backup.
portability_restore_preferences_desc: Theme, language, tab order, default layouts, installed plugins and AI service providers (without keys).
portability_restore_quota: The files in this backup do not fit your storage quota.
portability_restore_unknown: Some data in this backup comes from a feature this version does not have; it will be left out.
portability_restore_skipped: {count} items were skipped because what they belong to was not imported or they were invalid.
portability_replace_desc: Your current Programs, grades, schedules and other data will be deleted and replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone.
portability_storage_desc: Course files and Sem attachments share your storage. Backups don't count.
portability_storage_hint: Delete course files or Sem chats you no longer need to free up space.
portability_delete_desc: Permanently delete your account and all of its data.
portability_delete_dialog_desc: All Programs, grades, schedules, files and settings will be deleted, and you will be signed out on every device. Export a backup first if you want to keep anything.
portability_delete_acknowledge: I understand this cannot be undone
portability_deleted_desc: You have been signed out everywhere. We will send an email to your address once all of your data is gone.
error_portability_invalid_archive: This file is not a Semestra backup, or it is damaged.
error_portability_unsupported_version: This backup comes from a newer version of Semestra ({version}) and cannot be imported.
error_portability_legacy_backup: This is a backup from the old Semestra, which cannot be imported here.
error_portability_too_large: The backup is too large to upload.
error_portability_import_not_ready: This backup cannot be imported now.
auth_reauth_password_desc: For your security, enter your password to continue.
auth_reauth_sign_in: For your security, sign in again, then finish this within 10 minutes.
grading_category_active_hint: A category that's turned off can't be picked for new assessments. Assessments already in it stay as they are.
common_drag_instructions: To move a row, press space or enter on its handle, move it with the arrow keys, then press space or enter to drop it. Press Esc to cancel.
common_drag_cancelled: Cancelled. {name} is back where it was.
assistant_settings_memory_description: Sem can remember lasting things about you, such as preferences and goals, and use them in new conversations.
assistant_settings_memories_description: Edit or delete anything here. Sem only sees these in new conversations.
settings_memory_enabled_description: Sem saves lasting facts from your chats and reads them at the start of a conversation. Temporary chats never use memory.
assistant_memory_type_user_description: Your background, preferences and lasting constraints
assistant_memory_type_feedback_descripti: Your corrections and the approaches you want Sem to keep
assistant_memory_type_project_descriptio: Goals, plans and deadlines you're working towards
assistant_memory_type_reference_descript: Where to find things outside Semestra
assistant_memory_edit_description: Sem sees the summary in every new conversation and reads the details only when they matter.
assistant_memory_details_placeholder: Optional. Refer to another memory with [[its-name]].
assistant_memory_name_description: Sem uses the name to update and link this memory.
assistant_memory_name_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
assistant_memory_empty_description: Tell Sem something to remember, or keep chatting and it will note lasting facts.
assistant_memory_clear_description: Sem forgets everything it remembers about you. This cannot be undone.
assistant_temporary_chat_hint: Not saved to memory and not read from it
assistant_temporary_empty_description: Sem won't read your memories, and nothing from this conversation is saved to memory.
error_agent_memory_sensitive: Sensitive information such as passwords, ID numbers or health details is not saved to memory.
error_agent_memory_full: Memory is full. Delete some memories first.
error_agent_memory_off: Memory is turned off, so nothing was saved.
error_agent_memory_name_taken: Another memory already uses the name {name}.
grading_plan_unassumed: Not yet assumed: {count}. Assume a score for each to see the planned grade.
grading_round_before_lookup_hint: Rounds the course percentage to a whole number before looking up its band, as most transcripts do: 84.5% counts as 85%.
assistant_context_hint: When it fills up, Sem compacts on its own: older lookup results are cleared first, then older turns are summarized. The last two turns stay as they are.
assistant_compact_placeholder: What to keep (optional); press Enter to compact
